svg.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Arial, Noto Sans, Noto Sans CJK KR, sans-serif
svg.text: Guideline-adherence judgment workflow — rules decide; RAG supplies evidence and handles exceptions
A One verdict per patient × guideline × item (selection · dose · timing)
regimen R = agents started within 24 h
Pseudomonas risk: admission + IV abx ≤ 90 d
③ Find the matching row (rule table)
look up KR and INTL separately
R vs recommended S / alternative A
dose · route · timing are separate items
lower bound: undeterminable counted as non-adherent
condition outside the table / missing data
blind rating of both report types
B Regimen decision table — per patient, binary (example: severe CAP, no MRSA/Pseudomonas risk → S = ceftriaxone + azithromycin, A = levofloxacin)
e.g. levofloxacin alone · allergy data absent, so accepted without proof; share reported separately
adherent if the extra agent is explained by another risk row, else non-adherent (excess)
e.g. + vancomycin: adherent with MRSA history, excess without
R ⊂ S (only part of the recommendation)
e.g. ceftriaxone alone (azithromycin missing). Component overlap only as a secondary metric
e.g. cefepime + vancomycin without risk factors
no R · surgical cefazolin only · viral co-infection
an 'unknown' condition and candidate rows disagree
Undeterminable (out of denominator; non-adherent in the lower bound)
non-adherent but the card holds a reason
Justified deviation (only with evidence cited by clinician / LLM)
e.g. cefepime chosen for prior Pseudomonas isolate
• card variable absent from the guideline (lactate, CRP …)
→ not used in the verdict; context for the report only
• guideline condition absent from the card (allergy, multilobar imaging)
→ treated as 'unknown'; alternatives accepted as adherent without proof
• two antibiotics given, only one in the guideline
→ adherent if the risk factor is in the card, else non-adherent (excess)
→ judge each, report both; rule-table relation (common / conflict)
→ separate items; mg/kg drugs undeterminable without weight
• patients the guideline does not cover (prophylaxis, viral pneumonia)
→ not applicable; counted and removed from the denominator
→ removed from the denominator, plus a lower-bound rate counting them as non-adherent
• LLM verdict differs from the rule
→ compared on the sample only; the adherence rate comes from rules alone
Adherence (selection) = (recommended + alternative) ÷ (all − not applicable − undeterminable) · also report: n not applicable, n undeterminable, non-adherence subtypes, alternative share, lower bound
